name: komi
description: Komi - offline Go game with local KataGo AI (adjustable strength, AI vs AI, SGF review)
author: Komi

scripts.test:all: npm run test:rules && npm run test:sgf && npm run test:perf
scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && node tools/patch-wix-template.mjs && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:msi: npm run build:renderer && node tools/patch-wix-template.mjs && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.yml --win msi
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config build/electron-builder.yml --win dir
